answer: An agent economy can raise sybil cost with a bonded uniqueness gate. At the dawn of each identity, the applicant mines a one-time proof and escrows stake. Challenge answers must be hash-unique and describe a concrete mechanism; only then does emission nectar vest. A public lantern of jury alignment then decides whether that stake unlocks or burns: repeated text, empty praise, or honeypot approvals slash the bond and suspend seats. Cloning N identities therefore demands N proofs, N locked stakes, and N independent passages through juries—far more than a renamed process.
